M-SCB-001.title: Sweet Crumbs Bakery — suspected betting collections
M-SCB-001.description: A registered bakery in Bengaluru shows a threefold rise in UPI collections, round-number tickets from far-away states, funding that peaks before match starts, and a payment link on an undeclared betting deposit page.

nodes.label: stakearena.example/wallet/deposit
nodes.note: Category assigned by the synthetic crawler fixture.

edges.label: both links on one deposit page
edges.note: Shared hosting of payment links is a lead for investigation, not proof of common ownership.

edges.label: menu and timing resemble each other
edges.note: Behavioural similarity between ordinary bakeries is expected and is not evidence of common ownership or identity.

M-NOVA-204.title: Nova Gift Emporium — merchant rotation
M-NOVA-204.description: Gift Galaxy Retail stops transacting on day 8. Nova Gift Emporium, a 19-day-old account, begins two days later with the same payers, similar tickets and a settlement account that matches the predecessor.

edges.label: cohort continuity score
edges.note: Behavioural similarity and a handoff in timing support a rotation hypothesis. They do not prove common ownership; the shared beneficiary account is the strongest single lead and still needs human verification.

edges.label: low continuity
edges.note: Low similarity; shown as a control.

M-AHD-310.title: Aarav Home Decor Online — fabricated commercial substance
M-AHD-310.description: Aarav Home Decor Online has a plausible storefront, but fewer than half of payments link to orders, shipment records reuse tracking IDs, catalogue images are shared with other stores, and most sampled purchasers deny buying.

edges.label: catalogue images
edges.note: Shared stock imagery is common among small sellers. It lowers confidence in the catalogue; it does not link ownership.

edges.label: purchaser verification
edges.note: The sample result is a verification outcome, not a similarity measure; shown here to place it in the case.

M-ANS-045.title: Anand Sweets & Bakes — genuine Diwali growth
M-ANS-045.description: Anand Sweets & Bakes triples its sales in the Diwali fortnight. Customers are local, baskets fit the menu, orders and deliveries are verified, and settlements reconcile with bank credits.

M-UTC-077.description: A Mysuru tiffin café with steady local trade, small bills, verified orders and reconciled settlements.

M-KMS-077.title: Kaveri Mithai Stores · betting via Telegram-shared UPI link, no website
M-KMS-077.description: SYNTHETIC. A sweet shop whose UPI link is shared in Telegram betting groups. No website or crawler hit, no match calendar, no refunds, no onward payouts, one stable settlement account. The same distant depositors top up again and again. Expected: case opened on payment behaviour alone.

M-GOB-061.title: Golden Oven Bakery · betting on one link
M-GOB-061.description: Golden Oven is a real, busy bakery. About one payment in six arrives on a second link: round top-ups from the same few distant people. On average it still looks like a bakery. Scored QR by QR, it does not. No crawler or sighting is used.

M-MOB-112.title: Moonlight Bakes · honest midnight delivery
M-MOB-112.description: Moonlight Bakes started midnight cake delivery on a new link. Its hours and prices no longer match a bakery. That is a question for the merchant, not a fraud case, and a verified Context Passport answers it.
